title: Merge Guardians
core_loop: Drag and drop identical towers onto each other to merge them into a stronger tier. Merged towers auto-fire at enemies advancing in 3 horizontal lanes. Survive 60 seconds of escalating waves. Merge chain: Tier 1 (Basic) → Tier 2 (Double) → Tier 3 (Triple) → Tier 4 (Ultimate). Each merge refunds partial cost, encouraging experimentation.
controls: Mouse/touch drag-and-drop only. Drag a tower from the bottom tray onto the 4x4 grid to place (costs gold). Drag one placed tower onto another of the SAME tier to merge (free, refunds 50% of lower tier's cost). Tap/click a placed tower to sell for 75% refund. No menus, no wave button — waves auto-spawn every 8 seconds.
mechanics: 4x4 square grid (16 cells) with 3 horizontal enemy lanes (rows 1, 2, 3 from top); row 0 and row 3 are buffer zones for tower placement only
Four tower tiers per element: Fire (splash), Ice (slow), Lightning (chain), Poison (DoT) — 16 unique tower sprites total
Merge rule: same element + same tier → next tier (e.g., Fire T1 + Fire T1 = Fire T2). Cross-element merges forbidden. Tier 4 (Ultimate) cannot merge further
Gold economy: start with 150 gold. Kill reward: 8-12 gold scaling with enemy HP. Passive income: 5 gold/sec. Merge refund: 50% of sacrificed tower's cost. Sell refund: 75%

Enemy waves: 8-second intervals, 6-10 enemies per wave. Enemy types: Grunt (low HP, fast), Tank (high HP, slow), Shielded (immune to splash, vulnerable to chain), Healer (heals nearby allies, priority target)
Tower targeting: closest-to-exit in range. Fire T3/T4 splash radius 120px. Ice slows 60% for 2s. Lightning chains to 3 targets within 80px. Poison ticks 15 DPS for 4s

Ultimate abilities (Tier 4 only, 30s cooldown): Fire = meteor strike (300 dmg, 150px radius), Ice = deep freeze (stun all enemies 3s), Lightning = storm (hits all enemies 100 dmg), Poison = plague cloud (50 DPS, 200px, 8s)
Lives system: 10 lives. Grunt leaks = -1 life, Tank = -2, Shielded = -1, Healer = -3. Game over at 0 lives. Survive 60 seconds (8 waves) to win
Combo merge bonus: merging within 2s of previous merge grants +10% gold refund (stacks to +50% max). Encourages rapid merge chains during wave gaps
Visual clarity: towers show tier via border glow (T1=white, T2=green, T3=blue, T4=gold). Lane markers glow red when enemies in that lane exceed 3
juice: Merge animation: both towers scale to 1.3x, rotate ±15°, flash white, merge into new tower with 300ms elastic scale-in (Phaser elasticity 0.5)
Merge particles: 12 colored sparks burst from merge point, gravity 200, fade 400ms, color matches element (Fire=orange, Ice=cyan, Lightning=yellow, Poison=green)
Projectile feel: Fire = arcing lob with squash/stretch, Ice = crisp beam with hit pause 30ms, Lightning = jagged chain with 50ms delay per hop, Poison = homing dart with trailing particles
Enemy hit flash: 80ms white tint + 2px scale bump. Death: 15 particle burst matching damage type + floating gold text (+8 to +12) rising 60px over 800ms
Ultimate activation: full-screen color flash (element color, 100ms) + camera shake (150ms, 0.02 intensity) + slow-mo 0.3x for 400ms during effect
Wave start banner: "WAVE N" slides down from top (300ms, bounce ease), pauses 500ms, slides up. Lane glow pulses red 3x when wave spawns
Tower placement: ghost preview follows cursor (50% alpha). On valid drop: 200ms scale 0→1.1→1 with subtle screen shake (50ms, 0.005). Invalid drop: shake 100ms + red flash
Sell animation: tower dissolves into 8 gold coins that fly to gold counter (400ms arc), counter increments with number tween
Combo merge streak UI: small fireworks at screen top, streak counter scales 1.5x per increment, resets after 2s idle
Victory screen: confetti burst (50 pieces, 3s), "MERGE MASTER" title with gradient text, final stats (merges, ultimates used, gold earned), replay button with pulse animation
Defeat screen: grid grayscales, "OVERWHELMED" in red, last wave reached shown, retry button shakes gently every 2s
Background: subtle parallax layers (3 speeds) with element-themed ambient particles (embers, snowflakes, sparks, spores) — purely cosmetic, no gameplay impact
mvp_scope: Single 4x4 grid, 3 lanes, 4 elements × 4 tiers = 16 tower variants. 4 enemy types. 8 waves over 60 seconds. All graphics procedural: towers as layered geometric shapes (Fire=triangles, Ice=hexagons, Lightning=zigzags, Poison=blobs) with tier-appropriate detail. Projectiles as canvas-drawn shapes with blend modes. No external assets. UI: bottom tray (4 slots, one per element T1), gold counter top-right, lives top-left, timer top-center, combo streak top-right under gold. State machine: Boot → Preload → Tutorial (3 guided merges) → Play → Victory/Defeat → Replay.
win_lose_condition: Win: Survive 60 seconds (8 waves) with ≥1 life. Shows victory screen with merge count, ultimates fired, total gold, time survived. Lose: Lives reach 0 before 60s. Shows defeat screen with wave reached, merges performed, highest tier achieved. Both screens offer Replay (restarts same seed) and Menu (returns to tutorial).
